item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-44a0c78999eccdda","start_unit":15,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"In 2026, the Cyberspace Administration of China stated that Xi Jinping had emphasized centralized internet governance and responsibility of online platforms, and officials proposed a comprehensive revision of internet-service regulation after research, consultations, expert论证, and legislative evaluation.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Outside the 2023 target period; describes later institutional development and retrospective attribution to Xi.","ruler_attribution":"The official explanation attributes the governing direction to Xi Jinping and the central leadership, but the document concerns a 2026 draft rather than a 2023 action.","limitations":["The proposal is not evidence of enactment or implementation during 2023.","The official source does not independently assess effects on political freedom."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"During Xi Jinping’s August 2023 state visit to South Africa, China and South Africa agreed to deepen their comprehensive strategic partnership; they witnessed cooperation documents covering Belt and Road cooperation, new energy, agriculture, special economic zones, industrial parks, blue economy, technological innovation, and higher education.","question_ids":["2B.7","5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Chinese Foreign Ministry reported that Xi conducted the talks, made the four-point proposal, and witnessed the signed documents.","limitations":["The source records commitments and signed documents, not completed outcomes or independent evaluation.","The report is an official Chinese account."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On August 23, 2023, China defended Coast Guard action that reportedly chased and blocked Philippine resupply vessels near Second Thomas Shoal, describing it as necessary law-enforcement action and demanding that the Philippines stop actions that could complicate the situation.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","2B.6","2B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was issued by the Foreign Ministry spokesperson within the central government’s policy position; it does not document a personal order by Xi.","limitations":["The source presents China’s account and does not independently verify the incident.","No direct evidence here links the operational decision to Xi personally."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China stated in August 2023 that it opposed Japan’s planned Fukushima water discharge, had summoned Japan’s ambassador, urged Japan to cancel the plan, and threatened necessary measures to protect marine environment, food safety, and public health.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.10","6B.6","7B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Foreign Ministry presented the position as Chinese government policy; the document does not identify a personal Xi directive.","limitations":["The statement’s scientific claims and characterization of the discharge are contested and not independently evaluated here.","It records rhetoric and diplomatic action, not demonstrated environmental outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China said it had proposed a six-point humanitarian initiative for Ukraine and sent multiple batches of humanitarian supplies, while offering to continue efforts to ease the humanitarian situation.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement describes Chinese government action; it does not establish that Xi personally authorized each measure.","limitations":["No quantities, recipient verification, or independent assessment of impact are supplied.","The source is an official statement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China rejected U.S. allegations that Tibetan boarding schools forced assimilation, asserting that boarding schools addressed geographic and staffing constraints and that students could return home, use Tibetan-language and cultural courses, and wear traditional dress.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.6","6B.3","7B.1"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023 as an official defense of existing policy.","ruler_attribution":"The Foreign Ministry defended central government policy; the statement does not provide a personal Xi order.","limitations":["The source is a government denial and does not independently test the allegations or outcomes.","It supplies no disaggregated evidence on consent, attendance, or language use."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China’s August 2023 position on outer-space security rejected a limited U.S. commitment against destructive direct-ascent anti-satellite tests and called instead for negotiations on a legally binding instrument prohibiting deployment and use or threat of force against outer-space objects.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Foreign Ministry articulated the state position; no personal Xi decision is documented in the source.","limitations":["The statement does not show that China accepted or implemented a binding agreement.","It simultaneously used adversarial rhetoric toward the United States."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cb39a2dca228e466","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China stated in August 2023 that it supported a political settlement of Korean Peninsula tensions through a dual-track approach combining a peace mechanism and denuclearization, and urged meaningful dialogue and balanced resolution of legitimate concerns.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8","2B.1","2B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The statement records the central government’s diplomatic position, not a specifically documented Xi order.","limitations":["No implementation, negotiation result, or measurable de-escalation outcome is shown.","The source is an official statement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e50589cec325f0bf","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"At the 2014 NPT Review Conference, China’s delegation invited participants to visit China’s CTBT National Data Center; the surrounding compilation records other states’ support for the CTBT but provides no Chinese statement endorsing ratification or entry into force.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.7"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Outside the 2023 target period; historical evidence only.","ruler_attribution":"The document identifies a Chinese delegation action, not Xi Jinping personally.","limitations":["The supplied units do not establish China’s 2023 CTBT position or ratification conduct.","Most surrounding material concerns other states and is not attributed to China."]},{"source_id":"SRC-40f428e5df6586b8","start_unit":12,"end_unit":13,"fact_summary":"The CTBTO FAQ states that China signed the CTBT in 1996 but had not ratified it, and that China was among nine Annex 2 states whose ratification remained needed for the Treaty to enter into force.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The page is current and not confined to 2023; it documents a continuing institutional status relevant to the period.","ruler_attribution":"The status concerns the Chinese state; no personal Xi decision is identified.","limitations":["The source does not explain Xi’s reasons or identify decisions made in 2023.","The current webpage may reflect status after the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b80f4b2c7b7414e5","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A 2023 peer-reviewed study using CGSS 2010 survey data found that relative deprivation increased protest participation across worker categories, but migrant workers were significantly less likely than urban registered workers to protest when both perceived high unfairness; the result was robust across models.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.7","6B.3","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 but based on 2010 data; it does not measure Xi’s specific 2023 policies.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns social and institutional conditions in China, not a personal Xi action.","limitations":["The accessible text provides an abstract only and does not establish 2023 conditions.","The study identifies associations, not causal effects of Xi’s rule."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7ce89e7e26c821d6","start_unit":9,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"V-Dem’s archive identifies version 14, published in March 2024, as containing 2023-relevant country-year and country-date datasets, while version 13 was published in March 2023; the archive describes the available indicators and formats but supplies no China observation in the provided units.","question_ids":[],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The archive is a source-availability record spanning 2023–2024, not a substantive finding about Xi.","ruler_attribution":"No ruler attribution.","limitations":["No country-level value, trend, or institutional finding for China is provided.","The document cannot support a substantive judgment without the underlying dataset."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfd9055bfb6c67c8","start_unit":2,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"China’s Supreme People’s Court published 25 typical state-compensation cases illustrating that courts have awarded compensation, apologies, restitution, and other remedies for wrongful detention, torture, unlawful seizure, delayed medical care, erroneous execution, and other official abuses, while also upholding lawful police use of force in one case.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.9","4B.4","7B.2","7B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The cases span 1994–2018 and the publication is from 2020; they provide institutional background rather than a 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The document describes judicial institutions and historical cases, not a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["The cases do not establish 2023 implementation or Xi’s personal responsibility.","An official case-selection document may emphasize exemplary rather than representative outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3669db3ae2c7c4ed","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In July 2023, Xi met Solomon Islands Prime Minister Manasseh Sogavare and the two governments announced a comprehensive strategic partnership, signed cooperation documents in development, trade, infrastructure, aviation, education, police affairs, customs, and meteorology, and agreed to implement the Global Development, Security, and Civilization Initiatives.","question_ids":["2B.7","5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Foreign Ministry explicitly reported Xi’s meeting and joint announcement.","limitations":["The source records agreements and planned cooperation, not completed outcomes.","It does not independently assess the security implications of the police cooperation agreement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3669db3ae2c7c4ed","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China and Solomon Islands stated in July 2023 that their police cooperation agreement complied with international law and common practice and that China would support Solomon Islands’ peace and stability according to its will and needs.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.7","3B.2","8B.2"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The position was issued by the Foreign Ministry following Xi’s meeting with the Solomon Islands prime minister; the source does not show Xi’s personal role in drafting the agreement.","limitations":["The agreement’s text was not released in the supplied source.","The official characterization is not independently verified."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3669db3ae2c7c4ed","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China reported that more than 100 countries and international organizations supported the Global Development Initiative, nearly 70 countries joined its UN Group of Friends, half of 32 practical measures had been implemented or produced early results, and Chinese government programs provided 20,000 training opportunities through 1,000 human-resource-development programs.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.2","6B.4","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Reported in July 2023, with progress measured over the preceding two years.","ruler_attribution":"The program is explicitly attributed to Xi’s initiative and reported by the Foreign Ministry as a Chinese government effort.","limitations":["The figures are official claims without independent evaluation in the source.","The statistics concern international cooperation and do not isolate outcomes caused by Xi personally."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3669db3ae2c7c4ed","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In July 2023, China reaffirmed a defensive nuclear strategy, a minimum level required by national security, and a no-first-use policy, while stating it would not use or threaten nuclear weapons against non-nuclear-weapon states or nuclear-weapon-free zones.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Foreign Ministry stated the policy as an enduring Chinese commitment; the source does not document a new Xi directive in 2023.","limitations":["The statement is official rhetoric and does not independently verify operational posture or implementation.","It does not address the modernization evidence described in other sources."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3669db3ae2c7c4ed","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"An Arms Control Association analysis published in June 2023 reported that China’s nuclear warhead stockpile had exceeded 400 by 2022, with U.S. projections of 1,000 operational warheads by 2030 and 1,500 by 2035 if modernization continued.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and reports 2022 estimates and future projections relevant to Xi’s 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The article states that Xi, as Central Military Commission chairman, would have had to approve changes to China’s nuclear forces, but it does not prove the details of his personal decisions.","limitations":["The figures are estimates and projections, not direct 2023 inventory measurements.","The analysis says motivations remain uncertain."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae0007d498a8101b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In an April 2023 joint declaration with France, China endorsed preventing nuclear war and avoiding arms races, called for actions that would not aggravate tensions, supported the three pillars of the NPT, and backed diplomatic preservation of the Iran nuclear agreement and IAEA authority.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.8","2B.7","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The declaration followed Xi’s invitation and state visit by President Macron; it records a joint state commitment rather than a unilateral personal order.","limitations":["The document records commitments, not subsequent compliance or implementation.","The declaration is a bilateral diplomatic statement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae0007d498a8101b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The April 2023 China-France declaration called for peaceful settlement of disputes through dialogue and consultation, supported Ukraine peace efforts under international law, opposed attacks on nuclear facilities, and called for compliance with international humanitarian law and humanitarian access.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","2B.9","2B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The commitment was issued during a state visit hosted by Xi, but is jointly attributed to China and France.","limitations":["The declaration does not establish concrete enforcement or results.","It does not address all of China’s conduct in other conflicts or disputes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae0007d498a8101b","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China and France agreed in April 2023 to equitable and non-discriminatory market conditions in specified sectors, improved market access, protection of intellectual property, and cooperation in aviation, agriculture, nuclear energy, science, education, and cultural exchange.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","6B.2","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments were made during Xi’s state-level engagement with France and are jointly attributed to both governments.","limitations":["They are commitments and planned cooperation, not evidence of completed implementation or broad domestic regulatory change.","The declaration does not quantify economic or welfare outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ae0007d498a8101b","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The April 2023 declaration committed China and France to cooperation on food security, development finance, debt treatment, climate, biodiversity, ocean protection, plastics, forests, and energy transition, including China’s commitment to peak CO2 emissions before 2030 and strive for carbon neutrality before 2060.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.6","8B.1","8B.2","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023, though several targets extend beyond the period.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments were made by the Chinese government in a declaration issued during Xi’s state visit; they are not all personally attributed to Xi.","limitations":["Most targets are long-term and cannot be evaluated from 2023 evidence alone.","The declaration does not establish executed budgets, enforcement, or measured outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f936eeac48c8c1c","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"China’s Ministry of Education reported that in 2023 the nine-year compulsory-education consolidation rate reached 95.7%, senior-high gross enrollment reached 91.8%, higher-education gross enrollment reached 60.2%, and the education system had 291 million students and 18.9 million full-time teachers.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly measures 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ministry linked the education system’s direction to the Party Central Committee, State Council, and Xi’s directives, but the statistics are institutional rather than personally attributable.","limitations":["The figures are aggregate national indicators and do not show distribution or quality across groups.","The source is a government report without independent audit."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f936eeac48c8c1c","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In 2023, China reported nearly RMB 40 billion in central-government investment for compulsory-education gap projects, increased per-student public expenditure minimums, added 1,736 high-quality schools and 1.999 million places, and reported that over 95% of migrant workers’ children attended public schools or government-funded places.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.8","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly measures 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The Ministry of Education attributed implementation to Party Central Committee and State Council decisions and directives; no personal Xi expenditure decision is identified.","limitations":["The figures are preliminary or official administrative statistics.","The source does not provide independent verification of access quality, regional equality, or actual incidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f936eeac48c8c1c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"China’s 2023 vocational-education program reported 1,547 vocational colleges, 5.55 million enrollments, 684,600 full-time teachers, provincial and city industry-education partnerships, and new programs in manufacturing and the digital economy.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.10","6B.2","6B.4","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly measures 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The ministry described reforms as following central leadership and Xi’s directives, but the implementation is reported as ministry and provincial action.","limitations":["The source does not measure employment outcomes or whether training matched labor-market demand.","The statistics are official."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f936eeac48c8c1c","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"China reported higher-education initiatives in 2023 that created specialized colleges and programs in AI, semiconductors, quantum science, health, and energy; 45 national innovation hubs had undertaken over 1,100 projects; and a national student innovation program approved 41,956 projects involving 178,090 students.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.6","5B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.4","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly measures or reports 2023 activity.","ruler_attribution":"The ministry described the initiatives as responding to Xi’s directives and central decisions, but the source does not establish Xi’s personal role in each appointment or project.","limitations":["The source reports activity and scale, not independent assessments of quality or outcomes.","The figures are government-reported."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7581551090bab416","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Freedom House’s 2023 policy update states that China conducts the world’s most sophisticated, global, and comprehensive campaign of transnational repression and identifies a Chinese public-security official, Hu Binchen, as an Interpol executive-committee member.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The page identifies a 2023 update, but the supplied text contains policy recommendations and broader findings rather than a dated 2023 incident.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns the Chinese government; it does not establish a direct personal Xi order or action.","limitations":["The supplied text does not provide a case-level incident, date, or quantitative evidence of Xi’s personal involvement.","Freedom House’s characterization is an external institutional assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7581551090bab416","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Freedom House recommends that host governments treat targeted diaspora members as victims, track transnational-repression incidents, scrutinize extradition and Interpol requests from repressive states, restrict surveillance technology, protect encryption, sanction perpetrators, and expel involved diplomats.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The page is a policy-recommendation document with a 2023 update, not a direct 2023 event or finding about China’s conduct.","ruler_attribution":"No direct personal attribution to Xi; recommendations concern state conduct and host-state responses.","limitations":["These are recommendations, not evidence that the recommended conduct occurred.","The supplied units do not provide additional China-specific cases beyond the general assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ce6321316ecb9065","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"A June 2023 Arms Control Association analysis reported that China’s nuclear arsenal had expanded in size, accuracy, readiness, and diversity; estimated more than 400 warheads in 2022; and noted that the modernization could strengthen retaliation but also make credible nuclear-first-use threats in a conventional conflict.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published in June 2023 and evaluates developments continuing into the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The analysis states that Xi, as chairman of the Central Military Commission, would have had to approve changes, but motivations and exact decisions remain uncertain.","limitations":["The article emphasizes uncertainty and does not prove a shift to first use.","Some numerical estimates come from U.S. government or unofficial sources."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ce6321316ecb9065","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The analysis reports that China historically concentrated nuclear launch authority in the Politburo Standing Committee and Central Military Commission, stored warheads centrally while missiles remained dispersed at low peacetime readiness, but since around 2019 increased readiness and began more distributed warhead-handling practices.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.3","1B.8","1B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Historical baseline plus developments continuing into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The institutional posture is associated with China’s top civilian leadership; the article does not document a specific Xi order.","limitations":["The open-source evidence is incomplete and partly inferential.","The analysis says it is unclear whether China had decided to adopt launch-on-warning."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ce6321316ecb9065","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"China constructed three large missile-silo fields around 2020–2021, each with roughly 100 silos, and expanded dual-use DF-26 forces and other nuclear delivery systems, increasing redundancy and possible theater-strike options.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.5","1B.10","8B.3","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The construction and force changes predate but continued to shape the 2023 period.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the modernization to Chinese leadership and notes Xi’s formal authority, but does not identify a specific personal authorization.","limitations":["The sources do not establish the operational purpose of every silo or system.","Capability evidence does not by itself prove intent to use nuclear weapons."]},{"source_id":"SRC-ce6321316ecb9065","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The analysis states that Xi’s approval would have been required for changes to China’s nuclear forces, cites a Chinese scholar saying Xi personally planned and prepared strategic-force construction, and reports evidence that nuclear-policy experts may have been excluded from internal deliberations while missile-force influence increased.","question_ids":["1B.7","1B.10","8B.4","8B.5"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in 2023 and addresses the leadership and advisory structure behind the ongoing modernization.","ruler_attribution":"Xi is directly identified as the top authority who would have to approve force changes; the claim of personal planning is attributed to a Chinese scholar.","limitations":["The article explicitly says it remains unclear how Xi understood the purpose of the stronger force.","The reported exclusion and influence shifts are based on limited open-source evidence."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are outside the 2023 target period or provide only institutional background, current webpages, recommendations, or source-availability information.","Official Chinese sources frequently report policies, commitments, and statistics without independent verification of implementation, distribution, or outcomes.","No score is assigned."]}
